explanation: I found no Mathlib match. The theorem gives a q-expansion formula for the Hecke operator acting on differentials of the modular function field. That operator is the trace along the degeneracy map of the pullback along heckeBetaC. Every object in the statement is defined in the library itself: modularFunctionFieldC, jqModC, jqNModC, heckeAlphaC, heckeBetaC, charLDegeneracyRoof, traceDiff, pullbackDiff, qExpansionDiffAlong, qExpand and qTwist. Mathlib has no modular curves, no q-expansions of differentials on function fields and no Hecke operators of this kind. The proof just applies the library's own lemma ModularCurve.LevelHeckeDiff.main, not a Mathlib declaration. I did not run any searches: the statement is built entirely from the library's own constructions, so no Mathlib declaration could state it.
